direction_adjustment.rule: Multiply daily IC/spread by the preregistered direction sign before one-sided inference.

bootstrap.statistic: arithmetic mean of the date-level series
bootstrap.sampling: sample circular contiguous 20-date blocks with replacement until >=N observations, concatenate and truncate to N
bootstrap.one_sided_p_value: Center the direction-adjusted date series at zero by subtracting its observed mean; bootstrap the centered series; p=(1 + count(null_bootstrap_mean >= observed_direction_adjusted_mean))/(B+1).

multiplicity.family: the nine preregistered promotion-eligible factor hypotheses
multiplicity.p_values: one-sided centered circular moving-block bootstrap p-values for D+10 Rank-IC

quantiles.assignment: within-date rank using valid factor observations only
quantiles.ties: average rank then deterministic percentile bands
quantiles.spread: hypothesis-direction adjusted favorable extreme quintile minus unfavorable extreme quintile
quantiles.inference: same 20-date circular moving-block bootstrap, B=10000, seed=2801001 offset deterministically by factor id

quarter_stability.leave_one_valid_quarter_out: Every omission must retain positive direction-adjusted mean D+10 Rank-IC.

secondary_horizon.D_plus_5: direction-adjusted mean daily Rank-IC must be >0; no separate multiplicity significance requirement

missingness.excluded_date_rule: Dates failing coverage requirements are excluded from that factor's inference and counted in coverage diagnostics.
